'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[American military intervention in Somalia (2007–present)|American military intervention in Somalia]]
***A [[United States Air Force]] [[airstrike]] kills two [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[jihadist]]s in [[Buloburde]], [[Hiran, Somalia|Hiran]], [[Somalia]]. **[[Istana Negara attempted shooting]]
***A young woman belonging to [[Hizb ut-Tahrir]] attempts to shoot either the [[Presidential Security Force of Indonesia]] or the [[President of Indonesia]] [[Joko Widodo]] at the [[Istana Negara (Jakarta)|Istana Negara]] in [[Central Jakarta]], before being arrested. *[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Timeline of the Israeli–Palestinian conflict in 2022|2022 Israeli-Palestinian West Bank attacks]]
***[[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] raid a [[Lions' Den (militant group)|Lions' Den]] headquarter in [[Nablus]], [[West Bank]], killing three [[militant]]s, including one of the group's founders. Two [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[civilian]]s are also killed in nearby areas. Protests later occur in the town of [[Nabi Salih]], resulting in a Palestinian man being killed by Israeli soldiers. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-63383854 (BBC News)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/25/at-least-three-palestinians-killed-in-israeli-raids-on-nablus (Al Jazeera)]

**Gunmen kill two [[Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps]] officers, including a [[colonel]], in [[Zahedan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2022/10/25/Two-IRGC-members-killed-in-Iran-s-Zahedan-Report (Al Arabiya)]
*More than 30 people are killed and 15 others are reported missing after [[ritual warfare|tribal clashes]] on [[Kiriwina Island]] in [[Milne Bay Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. *[[Adidas]] and [[Def Jam Recordings]] terminate their respective [[Adidas Yeezy|Yeezy]] and [[GOOD Music]] partnerships with American rapper [[Kanye West]] in response to his recent [[antisemitic]] remarks. '''Business and economy'''
*[[Ford Motor Company|Ford]] announces that the [[Ford Fiesta|Fiesta]], [[Ford Fiesta (first generation)|introduced in 1976]] and now in its [[Ford Fiesta (seventh generation)|seventh generation]], will be discontinued, with production ending in mid-2023. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-63391466 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[List of earthquakes in 2022|Earthquakes of 2022]]
**Sixty-eight people are injured when a magnitude 6.4 [[List of earthquakes in the Philippines|earthquake]] strikes [[Cordillera Administrative Region]] and nearby [[Regions of the Philippines|regions]] in the [[Philippines]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1685379/43-hurt-as-quake-hits-north-luzon-anew/ (Philippine Daily Inquirer)]
*Eleven people, including several children, are killed and six others are injured in a fire at a [[school for the blind]] in [[Mukono District]], [[Uganda]]. [https://apnews.com/article/east-africa-uganda-kampala-fires-692cf2572b61029cfc2426c0203e8a13 (AP)]
*[[Finland|Finnish]] [[Seismology|seismologists]] at the [[University of Helsinki]] say that last week they detected five [[explosion]]s in [[Russia]]n [[territorial waters]] of the [[Baltic Sea]], with the largest explosion having a 1.8 magnitude. The cause of the blasts is currently unknown. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finnish-seismologists-detect-five-blasts-russian-waters-2022-10-25/ (Reuters)]
*Ten people are killed and nine others are injured when a truck and a minibus collide in [[Dakahlia Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-egypt-cairo-accidents-487aeca99ef6c7dbcca767aa658ede06 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in London]]
**Two people are killed and another is critically injured in a shooting in [[Ilford]], [[East London]]. A manhunt for the suspect is underway, according to the [[Metropolitan Police]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/two-men-dead-and-one-critically-injured-in-east-london-shooting-12729727 (Sky News)]
